rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying someone is skinny or thin, without stressing the bones.

example.english: I was bony when I was young.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 hou2 sau3

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when the person is strikingly bony or looks like a skeleton.

example.english: They are so bony they cannot even fill out their clothes.
example.traditional: 佢瘦到排骨咁，件衫都撐唔起。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sau3 dou3 paai4 gwat1 gam3 gin6 saam1 dou1 caang1 m4 hei2
